goals.summary: Keep option names and their usage/display casing independent from metavar annotations; metavars should affect display text only, not how an option is invoked.

facets.summary: Even when a metavar corresponds to the option name after lowercasing, it must not overwrite the option name's casing.
An option annotated with a custom metavar remains invoked using its option name, such as --name, rather than the metavar.
The stated intent is to restore the documented rule that metavars are for display and should not influence option usage, correcting a regression introduced in version 0.27.0.
The author notes this changes behavior from 0.27.0, while being less disruptive relative to 0.26.8.
The PR author reports that this change fixes the metavar-related option-name behavior.
The PR author reports adding tests, that updated tests fail on main and pass on the PR, and that coverage remains at 100%.
